description: Implementation of the PermissionCache class for managing permission checks and caching in Android.

classes.name: PermissionCache
classes.description: A singleton class that caches permission checks to improve performance.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Checks if a permission is granted for a specific UID.

methods.name: cache
methods.description: Caches the result of a permission check.

methods.name: checkCallingPermission
methods.description: Checks if the calling process has a specific permission.

methods.name: checkPermission
methods.description: Performs the actual permission check, consulting cache or performing system check.
